name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_asthma_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of asthma.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of asthma.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of asthma.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of asthma.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_asthma_now@@diagnosed_by_lung_function_tests
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current diagnosis of asthma was established by lung function tests.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current diagnosis of asthma was established by lung function tests.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current diagnosis of asthma was not established by lung function tests.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's current diagnosis of asthma was established by lung function tests.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_asthma_now@@diagnosed_by_typical_symptoms
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current diagnosis of asthma was established by typical symptoms.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current diagnosis of asthma was established by typical symptoms.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current diagnosis of asthma was not established by typical symptoms.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's current diagnosis of asthma was established by typical symptoms.

name: patient_inhaled_steroid_therapy_value_recorded_inthehistory_withunit_months
meaning: Numeric value representing the total duration in months of inhaled corticosteroid therapy the patient has received at any time in their history.
when_unknown: Set to null if the total duration of inhaled corticosteroid therapy is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the total number of months the patient has been treated with inhaled corticosteroids at any time in their history.

name: patient_has_other_significant_musculoskeletal_condition_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has other significant musculoskeletal conditions.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has other significant musculoskeletal conditions.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have other significant musculoskeletal conditions.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has other significant musculoskeletal conditions.

name: patient_has_significant_cardiopulmonary_condition_other_than_asthma_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a significant cardiopulmonary condition other than asthma.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a significant cardiopulmonary condition and it is not asthma.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have any significant cardiopulmonary condition other than asthma.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a significant cardiopulmonary condition other than asthma.
